fact: In a parliamentary answer reported on 29 October 2026, the ICT minister said draft amendments to the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 are prepared, covering deepfakes and harmful AI-generated content, and would create a Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Agency of Mauritius and platform takedown duties.
title: PQ : Réseaux sociaux : Le gouvernement prépare un nouveau cadre contre les abus
